name: magicpath
description: Search, inspect, install, export, create and edit MagicPath UI components from the agent. Runs Opulent's MagicPath bridge over the magicpath-ai 2.6.1 CLI, which Opulent machine images install pinned and integrity-checked, with your MagicPath CLI session: after `npx magicpath-ai login`, ~/.magicpath/session.json holds accessToken (save it as MAGICPATH_TOKEN) and refreshToken (MAGICPATH_REFRESH_TOKEN). When the access token expires or MagicPath rejects it, the bridge switches to the refresh token, which MagicPath issues for a year; when both have expired, sign in again and save the new pair. Connecting proves the session with a real authenticated call. Tools: magicpath_info, magicpath_search, magicpath_inspect, magicpath_list_projects, magicpath_list_components and magicpath_code_status read; magicpath_add and magicpath_code_export write files only in the workspace and never run a package manager; magicpath_code_start and magicpath_code_submit create or change components on your MagicPath canvas.
